data_facts_with_para.paragraph: A total of 28,310 couples registered their marriages in 2023, down from 29,389 in 2022.
A total of 28,310 couples registered their marriages in 2023, a 3.7 per cent fall from the record high of 29,389 marriages in 2022.

facts.fact_content: 3.7 per cent fall in marriages from 2022 to 2023.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: In 2023, there were over 28,000 marriages registered, which is over 2,000 marriages more than a decade ago. Overall, the five-year moving average for marriages has been stable.

facts.fact_content: Over 2,000 marriages more in 2023 than a decade ago.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: The proportion of male residents aged between 25 and 49 who were single increased from 31.2 per cent in 2013 to 35.4 per cent in 2023.

facts.fact_content: 31.2 per cent of male residents aged 25-49 were single in 2013.
35.4 per cent of male residents aged 25-49 were single in 2023.

data_facts_with_para.paragraph: The corresponding figure for women was 25.1 per cent in 2013, and this rose to 28.7 per cent in 2023, an MSF spokeswoman told The Straits Times.

facts.fact_content: 25.1 per cent of female residents aged 25-49 were single in 2013.
28.7 per cent of female residents aged 25-49 were single in 2023.
